gap: Both r5 items are genuinely closed and neither was closed by trading away something else. 'truncate' is gone: at 390px the third step wraps to two lines as 'Modules &' / 'Payment' with no ellipsis anywhere, and the mobile fold now carries the whole form, the CTA, and the top of the blue panel down to 'Card required today / None', so the reassurance is no longer entirely post-decision. State now reads in colour, not weight: the active label measures rgb(13,27,94) with a solid rgb(22,80,238) rule, the two upcoming labels rgb(92,104,160) with rgb(224,229,247) rules, and the muting stopped at the right place, 4.89:1 on the rgb(249,244,241) cream, so it clears AA rather than buying calm with a rule violation. The logo is vector in the headline navy, the apostrophe is U+2019, and the whole page holds three blues and one green with no shadow, glow or gradient. Against the bar's own folds, which stack a promo serif headline against the hero serif, crop a skewed dashboard off the right edge and lose their bottom tenth to a cookie bar, ours reads calmer and more composed. The biggest remaining thing is not the mobile card order. It is that the only piece of concrete example data on the page, the placeholder in the largest input, is 'Al Noor Trading LLC', and src/i18n/ui/*.json carries it transliterated into every locale (hi 'अल नूर ट्रेडिंग LLC', bn 'আল নূর ট্রেডিং LLC', ur 'النور ٹریڈنگ LLC'), so a Bengali or Hindi signup is invited to imagine itself as a Gulf trading company. The page's other real-world anchor, 'Secured by Paymob', points the same way, so every specific on an internationally positioned signup says Middle East, which is the same defect the brief already ruled out for OMR hero figures and Muscat-named seeded clients. Give each locale a plausible local example, or use a neutral one. Second, smaller and carried over unfixed from r5 item 4: signup.rail.note still ends 'with your records exactly where you left them', restating the 'Data if you leave / Yours to export' row four lines above it; cut it to the one clause the row does not carry, that stopping a paid module drops you to the free plan rather than closing the workspace.
